candidate.name: MCL Entry-Time Velocity-Breadth Router
candidate.base: v15 categorical three-horizon velocity breadth plus v13 failed-auction profit memory
candidate.change: decide small-response routing from the completed maturation snapshot nearest entry rather than the five-minute-old raw-turn snapshot
candidate.hypothesis: because v13 deliberately waits one completed five-minute bar, the continuation-versus-exhaustion decision should use velocity financing at that lawful entry boundary; stale raw-turn breadth should remain context, not sole direction authority

frozen_signal_and_lifecycle.engine: v15 exact macro CL engine with 6/12/24/48/96 completed five-minute horizons
frozen_signal_and_lifecycle.raw_turn_and_maturation: v15 exact raw turn plus exactly one completed five-minute maturation bar
frozen_signal_and_lifecycle.matched_mcl_parity: v15 exact direction-aligned raw-turn and maturation responses
frozen_signal_and_lifecycle.large_response: responses above three ticks remain failed-auction fades
frozen_signal_and_lifecycle.failed_auction_profit_memory: v13 exact 0.5 percent activation and 25 percent running-MFE retention
frozen_signal_and_lifecycle.roll_and_costs: v15 exact dual-volume roll, flat-until-fresh-turn law, and 3.52/5.52 costs

temporal_profiles.primary_maturation: for one-to-three-tick responses, follow when at least three horizon velocities in the completed maturation snapshot align with the raw direction; otherwise fade
temporal_profiles.neighbour_either: follow when either raw-turn or maturation breadth reaches three
temporal_profiles.neighbour_both: follow only when raw-turn and maturation breadth both reach three
temporal_profiles.admission: every unchanged v15 admission remains an admission; only routed direction may differ

selection_law: maturation-only breadth is the declared primary; either/both temporal compositions are sensitivity neighbors and cannot replace it from exposed outcomes
prohibitions: no breadth-count, parity, velocity-value, retention, or stop sweep
no added delay beyond the existing one-bar maturation
no abstention, daily quota, or synthetic re-entry
no target, timeout, session, direction, volatility, calendar, or news interaction
no crown or live authority from exposed history
